title: Identify Git-only capture work correctly in slow-operation warnings
outcome: Slow generic capture diagnostics identify the caller's work without attributing Git-only activity to Engram, using existing warning ownership.
acceptance: Generic source capture warning labels distinguish Git-only work from Engram source observation while retaining existing operation/caller ownership, the non-aborting warning and the caller's bounded wait.

A behavioral diagnostic control covers the affected label and confirms warning emission does not cancel or resend the operation; no repository Markdown phrase tests or parallel warning mechanism is added.
